title.purpose: Episode or song title under the cover.

volume.purpose: "Volume 40%" in place of the elapsed time during Option + scroll.

body.purpose: Artist or show line, list rows.

label.purpose: Hint pills and uppercase list headings.

shadows.name: cover-lift
shadows.purpose: Under the cover so it sits above the panel glass.

shadows.name: back-lift
shadows.purpose: Under the back of the cover.

motion.name: develop
motion.purpose: New cover artwork coming into focus; the title rises 6pt with it.

motion.name: cover-turn
motion.purpose: The cover turning over to show its list.

motion.name: give
motion.purpose: The cover yielding under the pointer.

motion.name: reduce-motion
motion.purpose: Replaces every motion above when Reduce Motion is on.

components.name: Hint Pill
components.description: Glass capsule on the cover's corner naming what's on the back.
components.html: Album
components.css: .ds-hint { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 4px; font: 600 10px -apple-system, sans-serif; color: #fff; padding: 4px 8px; border-radius: 999px; background: rgba(70,70,80,.55); backdrop-filter: blur(8px); box-shadow: inset 0 0 0 .5px rgba(255,255,255,.3); transition: transform .25s; } .ds-hint:hover { transform: scale(1.04); } .ds-hint:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid rgba(255,255,255,.6); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Resume Pill
components.description: Quiet glass capsule to return to a paused podcast while music plays.
components.css: .ds-resume { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 8px; width: 240px; padding: 4px 12px 4px 4px; border: 0; border-radius: 999px; font: 400 11px -apple-system, sans-serif; color: #fff; background: rgba(70,70,80,.35); backdrop-filter: blur(12px); box-shadow: inset 0 0 0 .5px rgba(255,255,255,.22); cursor: pointer; transition: background .2s, transform .2s; } .ds-resume:hover { background: rgba(90,90,100,.45); } .ds-resume:active { transform: scale(.98); } .ds-resume:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid rgba(255,255,255,.6); outline-offset: 2px; } .ds-resume-art { width: 22px; height: 22px; border-radius: 6px; background: linear-gradient(160deg,#2f5fd6,#0f2a73); } .ds-resume-k { color: rgba(235,235,245,.6); }

components.css: .ds-rows { width: 228px; padding: 6px; background: linear-gradient(160deg, rgba(120,40,95,.85), rgba(40,18,60,.85)); border-radius: 14px; } .ds-row { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 8px; height: 30px; padding: 0 6px; border-radius: 8px; font: 400 12px -apple-system, sans-serif; color: #fff; transition: background .15s; } .ds-row:hover { background: rgba(255,255,255,.08); } .ds-cur { background: rgba(255,255,255,.18); font-weight: 600; } .ds-key { box-shadow: inset 0 0 0 1.5px rgba(255,255,255,.55); } .ds-foot { text-align: center; padding-top: 6px; font: 400 11px -apple-system, sans-serif; color: rgba(235,235,245,.6); } .ds-n { width: 18px; text-align: right; color: rgba(235,235,245,.6); font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; } .ds-t { flex: 1; } .ds-d { color: rgba(235,235,245,.6); font-size: 11px; font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; }

components.name: Tab Switch
components.description: Episodes | Notes on the back of a podcast's cover.
components.css: .ds-tabs { display: flex; gap: 2px; width: 228px; padding: 2px; border-radius: 8px; background: rgba(255,255,255,.10); } .ds-tab { flex: 1; border: 0; background: transparent; color: #fff; font: 400 11px -apple-system, sans-serif; padding: 3px 0; border-radius: 6px; cursor: pointer; } .ds-tab:hover { background: rgba(255,255,255,.08); } .ds-tab:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid rgba(255,255,255,.6); } .ds-on { background: rgba(255,255,255,.22); font-weight: 600; }

components.name: Progress Line and Controls
components.description: A bold white progress line with the times under its ends, then back, play/pause and forward as plain symbols.
components.css: .ds-line { width: 240px; color: #fff; font: 400 11px -apple-system, sans-serif; } .ds-track { height: 6px; border-radius: 3px; background: rgba(255,255,255,.22); overflow: hidden; transition: height .15s; } .ds-track:hover { height: 8px; } .ds-track i { display: block; width: 30%; height: 100%; background: #fff; border-radius: 3px; } .ds-times { display: flex; justify-content: space-between; margin-top: 4px; color: rgba(235,235,245,.6); font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; } .ds-ctl { display: flex; justify-content: center; align-items: center; gap: 26px; margin-top: 8px; } .ds-ctl button { background: none; border: 0; color: #fff; font-size: 20px; padding: 6px; transition: transform .15s; } .ds-ctl button:hover { transform: scale(1.06); } .ds-ctl button:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid rgba(255,255,255,.6); outline-offset: 2px; border-radius: 8px; } .ds-ctl .ds-play { font-size: 26px; }

components.name: Source Dot
components.description: 6pt dot after the artist name saying where a song plays.
components.css: .ds-artist { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 5px; font: 400 12px -apple-system, sans-serif; color: rgba(235,235,245,.6); } .ds-dot { width: 6px; height: 6px; border-radius: 50%; background: #1ED760; }

narrative.overview: sideB is a cover you can turn over. On the front, what's playing and nothing else; on the back, the album, the playlist or the episodes it belongs to. It hangs at the edge of the author's work in the menu bar, is touched for a moment, and is gone. It should feel tactile, calm and precise: the cover gives under the pointer and turns like a real sleeve, nothing shouts, every detail is exact. The material is the see-through window glass macOS draws (AppKit NSGlassEffectView), tinted with the cover's colour; sideB adds no colour of its own. A 272 pt panel holds a 240 pt cover, a title, the progress line and its controls and, when needed, one pill. The mini player is just the cover in a thin glass frame.
keyCharacteristics: Window glass everywhere the app has a surface; SwiftUI glass only for small controls inside it.
Colour comes from artwork and the desktop; sideB's own ink is white at a few opacities.
System type (SF Pro) at small, exact sizes; tabular digits for every time.
Soft springs for every change; Reduce Motion always gets a plain crossfade.
One gesture per thing: drag or scroll the progress line, press play, click the cover.

rules.name: The Borrowed Colour Rule
rules.body: sideB never paints a surface with a colour of its own. Colour comes from the artwork, the desktop through the glass, or the two source dots.

rules.name: The Label Ink Rule
rules.body: Anything that must read as white on glass uses NSColor.labelColor; .primary and .foreground render grey there.

rules.name: The Same Size Rule
rules.body: Paired values keep one size: elapsed and remaining times never shrink independently; when space runs out, move them rather than scale them.

rules.name: The One Lift Rule
rules.body: Only the cover lifts. Pills, rows, the progress line and the buttons sit in the glass, not on it.

rules.name: The Parallel Corners Rule
rules.body: An inner radius is the outer radius less the gap between them.

dos: Do put window glass (NSGlassEffectView) behind every surface that should see the desktop: the panel and the mini player, tinted with the cover's colour.
Do draw white ink with NSColor.labelColor.
Do nest corners: 30 pt panel → 14 pt cover → 8 pt rows → 6 pt thumbs.
Do use tabular digits for every time and number.
Do give every motion a Reduce Motion crossfade.
Do draw glyphs in code (play, pause, skip, library).
donts: Don't use SwiftUI .glassEffect for a whole window's surface: it only sees inside its own clear window and renders flat grey.
Don't use Apple logos, product artwork or SF Symbols in sideB's own controls.
Don't shrink one of a pair of values (elapsed and remaining time) to make it fit.
Don't add a window shadow to the panel; the glass carries its own.
Don't open a second window for something the panel can show in place (the list lives on the back of the cover).
Don't paint surfaces with sideB's own colour.
